latest_posts.hook: Anthropic now recommends collapsing a lot of multi-agent systems back into one main agent. / Not because subagents are dead.
OpenAI solved one of the Millennium Prize Problems with 10,000 AI agents. / This is one of those days people will point back to.
One Gemini agent found a cheat code. The others formed a society around it. / That’s the short version of a new DeepMind preprint.
latest_posts.topic: DeepMind emergent cheating and whistleblowing in autonomous research swarms

latest_posts.hook: ChatGPT just got its AGI model: GPT-6 Astra. / AI is absorbing every layer of software.
Gemini 3.8 Flash is getting close to Opus-tier scores for a fraction of the price. / Google just released the new Flash model, and this is the simple story:
OpenAI is cutting Cursor off from its models. Cursor’s reply was basically: that’s 5% of our traffic. / That is a nasty little number.
GLM-5.3 is Fable-level AI you can download and run yourself. / Z.ai launched the model on August 18. Ten days later, the official weights landed on Hugging Face.
SpaceXAI just released Grok Bot: a messenger for your agents. / You log in once, give bots the access they need, and each agent gets its own virtual computer.
Qwen 3.8-Max can work autonomously for 16 days. / That sentence sounds insane until you realize where agents are going.
Claude Cowork just killed the repetitive tasks that live in your head. / New feature: Record a skill.
AI agents attacked Hugging Face. Another LLM helped defend it. / That’s the part worth paying attention to.
Kimi K3 is open, almost 2x cheaper than Opus 4.8, and already beating it. / Moonshot’s new model doesn’t beat Fable and Sol everywhere.
latest_posts.topic: Kimi K3 open-source frontier model catching up
